# Leonardo Faoro

> Engineer. Hacker. Thinkerer. Building open-source tools for security, infrastructure, and the command line.

Leonardo Faoro is a software engineer working on open-source developer tools in Go. His work spans SSH tooling, terminal user interfaces, DNS management, security auditing, cryptocurrency payments, and agent harness engineering. Reachable by email at me@leonardofaoro.com.

## Projects

- [flares](https://github.com/lfaoro/flares): Cloudflare DNS backup tool for secure DNS management and backup operations.
- [ssm](https://github.com/lfaoro/ssm): Fast, keyboard-driven TUI that makes your existing ~/.ssh/config delightful to use at fleet scale.
- [swap](https://github.com/lfaoro/swap): Terminal UI for cross-chain cryptocurrency swaps with optimal rates and privacy.
- [spark](https://github.com/lfaoro/spark): Fireblaze Vault tokenization service for secure storage of sensitive data.
- [trailblaze](https://github.com/lfaoro/trailblaze): SSH auditing and network scanning for comprehensive security assessment.
- [skel](https://github.com/lfaoro/skel): Dotfiles configuration management using Nix for reproducible development environments.
- [All repositories](https://github.com/lfaoro): GitHub profile.
